name: EM Carry-to-Vol Rank: Monthly FX Returns by Rank
description: Ranks BRL, MXN, ZAR, TRY, COP by carry-to-vol each month (carry = local 3M interbank rate minus USD Fed Funds, vol = 21-day realized vol on FX close returns). Rank 1 = lowest carry-to-vol, Rank 5 = highest. Shows avg next-month EM/USD return by rank (bar chart), N/median/hit rate/mean per rank (summary table), and carry-to-vol over time (line chart). Last 10 years.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EM CARRY-TO-VOL RANK: DO HIGH-CARRY EM CURRENCIES OUTPERFORM NEXT MONTH?
# =============================================================================
# Universe: BRL, MXN, ZAR, TRY, COP (all quoted as USD/EM, i.e. USDBRL etc.)
# Carry = local 3M interbank rate - USD Fed Funds (% per annum)
# Vol   = 21-day realized vol on daily FX close returns (annualized, decimal)
# Carry-to-Vol = carry / (vol * 100)  [both in % units for comparability]
# Rank 1 = lowest carry-to-vol, Rank 5 = highest (ascending=True)
# Forward return = next-month EM/USD return (inverted from USD/EM pair)
# =============================================================================

bar_idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# FX DATA: USD/EM pairs (rising = EM weakening, so we invert for EM return)
# =============================================================================

brl_fx = fx_pairs(ticker='USDBRL')()
mxn_fx = fx_pairs(ticker='USDMXN')()
zar_fx = fx_pairs(ticker='USDZAR')()
try_fx = fx_pairs(ticker='USDTRY')()
cop_fx = fx_pairs(ticker='USDCOP')()

brl_close = brl_fx.c
mxn_close = mxn_fx.c
zar_close = zar_fx.c
try_close = try_fx.c
cop_close = cop_fx.c

# =============================================================================
# LOCAL INTEREST RATES (monthly FRED → ffill to daily)
# Brazil:  IRSTCI01BRM156N  — overnight call money rate (% p.a.)
# Mexico:  IR3TIB01MXM156N  — 3M interbank rate (% p.a.)
# S.Africa: IR3TIB01ZAM156N — 3M interbank rate (% p.a.)
# Turkey:  IRSTCI01TRM156N  — overnight call money rate (% p.a.)
# Colombia: COLIR3TIB01STM  — 3M interbank rate (% p.a.)
# USD:     FEDFUNDS         — Fed Funds effective rate (% p.a.)
# =============================================================================

brl_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01BRM156N')()
mxn_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01MXM156N')()
zar_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01ZAM156N')()
try_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01TRM156N')()
cop_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='COLIR3TIB01STM')()
usd_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='FEDFUNDS')()

brl_rate = ffill(brl_rate_raw.result)
mxn_rate = ffill(mxn_rate_raw.result)
zar_rate = ffill(zar_rate_raw.result)
try_rate = ffill(try_rate_raw.result)
cop_rate = ffill(cop_rate_raw.result)
usd_rate = ffill(usd_rate_raw.result)

# =============================================================================
# CARRY = local rate - USD Fed Funds (% per annum)
# =============================================================================

brl_carry = brl_rate - usd_rate
mxn_carry = mxn_rate - usd_rate
zar_carry = zar_rate - usd_rate
try_carry = try_rate - usd_rate
cop_carry = cop_rate - usd_rate

# =============================================================================
# 21-DAY REALIZED VOL on FX close returns (annualized, decimal fraction)
# volatility() outputs annualized decimal (e.g. 0.12 = 12% vol)
# Convert to % for carry-to-vol: vol_pct = vol_decimal * 100
# =============================================================================

brl_vol = volatility(period=21)(brl_close)
mxn_vol = volatility(period=21)(mxn_close)
zar_vol = volatility(period=21)(zar_close)
try_vol = volatility(period=21)(try_close)
cop_vol = volatility(period=21)(cop_close)

# Convert to % units to match carry (both in % p.a.)
brl_vol_pct = brl_vol * 100.0
mxn_vol_pct = mxn_vol * 100.0
zar_vol_pct = zar_vol * 100.0
try_vol_pct = try_vol * 100.0
cop_vol_pct = cop_vol * 100.0

# =============================================================================
# CARRY-TO-VOL = carry (% p.a.) / vol (% p.a.)
# Guard: only compute when vol > 0 to avoid division by zero
# =============================================================================

brl_ctv = where(is_valid(brl_vol_pct) and brl_vol_pct > 0.0, brl_carry / brl_vol_pct)
mxn_ctv = where(is_valid(mxn_vol_pct) and mxn_vol_pct > 0.0, mxn_carry / mxn_vol_pct)
zar_ctv = where(is_valid(zar_vol_pct) and zar_vol_pct > 0.0, zar_carry / zar_vol_pct)
try_ctv = where(is_valid(try_vol_pct) and try_vol_pct > 0.0, try_carry / try_vol_pct)
cop_ctv = where(is_valid(cop_vol_pct) and cop_vol_pct > 0.0, cop_carry / cop_vol_pct)

# =============================================================================
# CROSS-SECTIONAL RANK at each bar (ascending: rank 1 = lowest carry-to-vol)
# cs_rank runs across all 5 assets simultaneously at each timestamp
# =============================================================================

brl_rank = cs_rank(ascending=True)(brl_ctv)
mxn_rank = cs_rank(ascending=True)(mxn_ctv)
zar_rank = cs_rank(ascending=True)(zar_ctv)
try_rank = cs_rank(ascending=True)(try_ctv)
cop_rank = cs_rank(ascending=True)(cop_ctv)

# =============================================================================
# MONTHLY REBALANCE: sample rank and carry-to-vol at month-start boundaries
# =============================================================================

is_month_start = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month, boundary=BoundaryType.start)(bar_idx)

brl_rank_m = where(is_month_start, brl_rank)
mxn_rank_m = where(is_month_start, mxn_rank)
zar_rank_m = where(is_month_start, zar_rank)
try_rank_m = where(is_month_start, try_rank)
cop_rank_m = where(is_month_start, cop_rank)

brl_ctv_m = where(is_month_start, brl_ctv)
mxn_ctv_m = where(is_month_start, mxn_ctv)
zar_ctv_m = where(is_month_start, zar_ctv)
try_ctv_m = where(is_month_start, try_ctv)
cop_ctv_m = where(is_month_start, cop_ctv)

# =============================================================================
# NEXT-MONTH FX RETURN (EM/USD appreciation)
# forward_returns(period=21) on daily close → 21-bar ahead return
# Invert: EM/USD return = -1 * USD/EM return
# Sample at month-start so each observation is a clean monthly forward return
# =============================================================================

brl_fwd_raw = forward_returns(period=21)(brl_close)
mxn_fwd_raw = forward_returns(period=21)(mxn_close)
zar_fwd_raw = forward_returns(period=21)(zar_close)
try_fwd_raw = forward_returns(period=21)(try_close)
cop_fwd_raw = forward_returns(period=21)(cop_close)

# Invert: positive = EM currency appreciated vs USD
brl_fwd = -1.0 * brl_fwd_raw
mxn_fwd = -1.0 * mxn_fwd_raw
zar_fwd = -1.0 * zar_fwd_raw
try_fwd = -1.0 * try_fwd_raw
cop_fwd = -1.0 * cop_fwd_raw

# Sample forward returns at month-start (aligned with rank observation)
brl_fwd_m = where(is_month_start, brl_fwd)
mxn_fwd_m = where(is_month_start, mxn_fwd)
zar_fwd_m = where(is_month_start, zar_fwd)
try_fwd_m = where(is_month_start, try_fwd)
cop_fwd_m = where(is_month_start, cop_fwd)

# =============================================================================
# RANK-BUCKETED FORWARD RETURNS
# For each rank 1-5, collect all monthly forward returns where that rank was assigned
# Combine across all 5 currencies (each currency contributes to one rank per month)
# =============================================================================

# Rank 1 (lowest carry-to-vol) forward returns per currency
brl_r1 = where(is_valid(brl_rank_m) and brl_rank_m == 1.0, brl_fwd_m)
mxn_r1 = where(is_valid(mxn_rank_m) and mxn_rank_m == 1.0, mxn_fwd_m)
zar_r1 = where(is_valid(zar_rank_m) and zar_rank_m == 1.0, zar_fwd_m)
try_r1 = where(is_valid(try_rank_m) and try_rank_m == 1.0, try_fwd_m)
cop_r1 = where(is_valid(cop_rank_m) and cop_rank_m == 1.0, cop_fwd_m)

# Rank 2
brl_r2 = where(is_valid(brl_rank_m) and brl_rank_m == 2.0, brl_fwd_m)
mxn_r2 = where(is_valid(mxn_rank_m) and mxn_rank_m == 2.0, mxn_fwd_m)
zar_r2 = where(is_valid(zar_rank_m) and zar_rank_m == 2.0, zar_fwd_m)
try_r2 = where(is_valid(try_rank_m) and try_rank_m == 2.0, try_fwd_m)
cop_r2 = where(is_valid(cop_rank_m) and cop_rank_m == 2.0, cop_fwd_m)

# Rank 3
brl_r3 = where(is_valid(brl_rank_m) and brl_rank_m == 3.0, brl_fwd_m)
mxn_r3 = where(is_valid(mxn_rank_m) and mxn_rank_m == 3.0, mxn_fwd_m)
zar_r3 = where(is_valid(zar_rank_m) and zar_rank_m == 3.0, zar_fwd_m)
try_r3 = where(is_valid(try_rank_m) and try_rank_m == 3.0, try_fwd_m)
cop_r3 = where(is_valid(cop_rank_m) and cop_rank_m == 3.0, cop_fwd_m)

# Rank 4
brl_r4 = where(is_valid(brl_rank_m) and brl_rank_m == 4.0, brl_fwd_m)
mxn_r4 = where(is_valid(mxn_rank_m) and mxn_rank_m == 4.0, mxn_fwd_m)
zar_r4 = where(is_valid(zar_rank_m) and zar_rank_m == 4.0, zar_fwd_m)
try_r4 = where(is_valid(try_rank_m) and try_rank_m == 4.0, try_fwd_m)
cop_r4 = where(is_valid(cop_rank_m) and cop_rank_m == 4.0, cop_fwd_m)

# Rank 5 (highest carry-to-vol)
brl_r5 = where(is_valid(brl_rank_m) and brl_rank_m == 5.0, brl_fwd_m)
mxn_r5 = where(is_valid(mxn_rank_m) and mxn_rank_m == 5.0, mxn_fwd_m)
zar_r5 = where(is_valid(zar_rank_m) and zar_rank_m == 5.0, zar_fwd_m)
try_r5 = where(is_valid(try_rank_m) and try_rank_m == 5.0, try_fwd_m)
cop_r5 = where(is_valid(cop_rank_m) and cop_rank_m == 5.0, cop_fwd_m)

# Merge rank buckets: coalesce across currencies (only one is non-NaN per month per rank)
r1_ret = coalesce(brl_r1, mxn_r1, zar_r1, try_r1, cop_r1)
r2_ret = coalesce(brl_r2, mxn_r2, zar_r2, try_r2, cop_r2)
r3_ret = coalesce(brl_r3, mxn_r3, zar_r3, try_r3, cop_r3)
r4_ret = coalesce(brl_r4, mxn_r4, zar_r4, try_r4, cop_r4)
r5_ret = coalesce(brl_r5, mxn_r5, zar_r5, try_r5, cop_r5)

# Hit rate flags (1 = positive return, 0 = negative)
r1_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(r1_ret) and r1_ret > 0.0) else (0.0 if is_valid(r1_ret) else r1_ret)
r2_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(r2_ret) and r2_ret > 0.0) else (0.0 if is_valid(r2_ret) else r2_ret)
r3_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(r3_ret) and r3_ret > 0.0) else (0.0 if is_valid(r3_ret) else r3_ret)
r4_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(r4_ret) and r4_ret > 0.0) else (0.0 if is_valid(r4_ret) else r4_ret)
r5_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(r5_ret) and r5_ret > 0.0) else (0.0 if is_valid(r5_ret) else r5_ret)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: Carry-to-Vol over time (5 lines, one per currency)
# Dense daily series — suitable for xy_lines
# =============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Carry-to-Vol by Currency (Which EM Offers the Best Compensated Carry?)',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    y_axis_label='Carry-to-Vol (carry % / realized vol %)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BRL', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='MXN', color=Color.Cyan),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ZAR', color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='TRY', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='COP', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=bar_idx, y_values=(brl_ctv, mxn_ctv, zar_ctv, try_ctv, cop_ctv))

# =============================================================================
# CHART 2: Avg next-month EM/USD return by carry-to-vol rank
# Grouped bar chart: 5 rank buckets, each showing avg return
# Uses BarSeriesSchema series mode (no label input)
# =============================================================================

xy_bars(
    title='Does High Carry-to-Vol Predict Next-Month EM Appreciation?',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rank 1 (Lowest)', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rank 2', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rank 3', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rank 4', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rank 5 (Highest)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(r1_ret, r2_ret, r3_ret, r4_ret, r5_ret))

# =============================================================================
# TABLE: N / Median / Hit Rate / Mean per rank (RowSpec GROUP BY mode)
# Inputs: (return_series, rank_number_series)
# rank_number_series = 1 for rank-1 obs, 2 for rank-2 obs, etc.
# Build a combined rank-label series for RowSpec grouping
# =============================================================================

# Rank label series: integer 1-5 at each month-start observation
rank_label = coalesce(
    where(is_valid(r1_ret), 1.0),
    where(is_valid(r2_ret), 2.0),
    where(is_valid(r3_ret), 3.0),
    where(is_valid(r4_ret), 4.0),
    where(is_valid(r5_ret), 5.0)
)

# Combined return series (one non-NaN value per month-start per rank slot)
all_rank_ret = coalesce(r1_ret, r2_ret, r3_ret, r4_ret, r5_ret)
all_rank_hit = coalesce(r1_hit, r2_hit, r3_hit, r4_hit, r5_hit)

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Next-Month EM/USD Return by Carry-to-Vol Rank',
        col_headers=['Rank 1', 'Rank 2', 'Rank 3', 'Rank 4', 'Rank 5'],
        col_size=5,
        row_size=4,
        rows=[
            RowSpec(name='N (Months)', agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
            RowSpec(name='Median Return', agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            RowSpec(name='Hit Rate', agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            RowSpec(name='Mean Return', agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    order=2
)(all_rank_ret, rank_label)
